# Draft:Dr. Ismail Warad

Dr. Ismail Warad is a full professor in the Chemistry Department at An-Najah National University in Nablus, Palestine. He earned a BSc in Applied Chemistry from An-Najah University in 1995 and an MSc in Physical Chemistry in 1998. In 2003, he obtained a Ph.D. in Organometallic Chemistry from the University of Tübingen, Germany. From 2003 to 2005, he worked in the Chemistry Department at the University of Tübingen.
In 2005, he joined King Saud University in Saudi Arabia as an assistant professor, where he worked until 2011. In 2011, he returned to An-Najah National University, where he was later promoted to full professor in 2016. From 2019 to 2022, he worked at Qatar University’s Chemistry Department. He also served as the Dean of Scientific Research at An-Najah National University from 2022 to 2024.
Dr. Warad has authored two books, holds nine patents, and has published more than 600 research papers. His academic and research contributions span Germany, India, Saudi Arabia, and Palestine.
